name: Ti Top Island
kicker: Sand and a climb on the long boat
summary: Crescent island on the long boat: swim, kayak, and climb the view inside a 5–6 hour route. Hồ Chí Minh named it for the 1962 visit with Gherman Titov, the only island in the bay named that way. Beach games on the sand are a separate charge. Go in the morning, before the boats stack up.
getThere: Route 2 boat from the Ha Long passenger port
heroCaption: The crescent of sand, the slope, and working boats

notice.title: Beach games have no printed price
notice.body: Beach games on the sand are separate from the route ticket. The 5–6 hour clock covers Ti Tốp, Sửng Sốt, and Luồn together.

body: You land on the crescent. Hồ Chí Minh named the island for the 1962 visit with the Soviet cosmonaut Gherman Titov. You can swim, kayak, and climb to the view.
The clock is route 2, 5–6 hours for Ti Tốp, Sửng Sốt, and Luồn together. Go in the morning, before the midday boats stack on the sand.

figures.caption: The bay from the top, with foliage in front
figures.alt: Ha Long Bay seen from the top of Ti Top Island

gettingThere: Route 2 from Cảng tàu khách quốc tế Hạ Long. The English port line is Beach road, New Beach, Bai Chay ward, 500 m from Sun World. The route is 5–6 hours for this island, Sửng Sốt, and Luồn together.

legs.heading: From the Ha Long port
legs.body: The route-2 boat from the Ha Long passenger port. The clock is the whole 5–6 hour route.

closed: No weekly closing day was printed. Confirm the sailing the day you go.
admissionNote: No separate island price. Route 2 on 15 March 2024 is 490,000–510,000 đồng. Beach games are a separate charge. From 10 December 2025 a bay ticket needs an identity card or a passport.
